title: Paper 1 extraction record, form v0.1 (draft, not frozen)
description: One JSON object per included study, one line in the session output file. Field ids (M01, S01, D01, F1, CT, CL, QA1, U-fields, K-fields) match the field table in EXTRACTION-PLAN.md section 3. Fields marked x-filled-by 'script' or 'metadata' are left null by the extractor and filled afterwards; the extractor never writes them. The top-level 'evidence' array is read unchanged by analysis/screening/quote_check.py (it reads 'id' and 'evidence[].quote'; 'cond' names the field or unit a quote supports).

id.description: M01 record id exactly as in dispatch.json (e.g. M00285).

form_version.description: M10 form version; the dispatch states it.

extractor.description: M09 role and model, e.g. EA-claude-opus-5-5. EA/EB pilot extractors, ER second reader, EC adjudicator; the production extractor writes EA.

ft.description: M04 full-text version string copied from dispatch.json.

meta.description: M02, M03, M05, M06, M07, M08: filled by script from the corpus and screening files after the session; null in extractor output.

bibliographic.description: M02 title, authors, arXiv id, DOI, OpenReview id.

first_version_date.description: M03 YYYY-MM-DD of the first public version.

venue_resolved.description: M05 / QA10 resolved peer-review status of the published version (protocol s3 'Version rated').

text_generator.description: S03 what generates the text in the paper's own model.

state_space.description: S04 protocol s5 categories; more than one only for analysis or benchmark studies of several models.

task_families.description: S05 every family with a generated-sample result of the paper's own method; empty for theory with no experiment.

task_other.description: S05 free text naming the tasks put in 'other'; '' if none.

primary_task_family.description: S06 family of the F1 headline task; NA when F1 is NA.

models.description: S07 the paper's own models with sizes as printed.

base_checkpoints.description: S08 named pretrained models the paper loads (e.g. 'LLaDA-8B-Instruct'); empty if trained from scratch or none named.

training.description: S09 training data and compute (protocol s5).

data_named.description: datasets named for the paper's own training, '' if none, 'not_stated'

tokens_printed.description: training tokens or samples as printed, or 'not_stated'

compute_printed.description: GPU-hours, FLOPs or hardware x time as printed, or 'not_stated'

main_sampler.description: S10 sampler and function evaluations for the F1 setting (protocol s5).

nfe_printed.description: as printed, or 'not_stated'; never computed by the extractor

affiliations.description: S11 institutions on the title page, as printed (for 'independent groups', protocol s7).

venue_line_text.description: S12 / QA10 venue statement printed in the file (e.g. 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2022'), or 'none'.

credited_component.description: S13 first contribution the introduction lists (abstract if no list), short; 'NA' for studies with no method.

main_comparison.description: S14 unit id of the main comparison (EXTRACTION-PLAN s5.3), or 'NA'.

design.description: Block D: design-space choices C1-C5 (framework-v1 s1 with framework-v2 corrections).

c1_channel.description: D01 one entry per modality the model generates.

c2_reveal.description: D02 training reveal law for the text (or only) modality.

c2_multimodal.description: D03 joint reveal law across modalities; NA for single-modality models.

c4_position.description: D07 position rule of the F1 sampler.

levers.description: D12 lever rows the paper's own method uses (framework-v1 s3 order).

other_detail.description: D14 free text for every 'other' above; '' if none.

design_fit.description: D13 derived: yes if no D01-D11 value is 'other', else partly.

census.description: Block F: census fields F1-F6 under codebook v1.2 (consolidated in the extractor brief).

F1_unit.description: F1 unit id of the H unit with is_F1 true, or 'NA' when F1_status is QL or NA.

F2_codes.description: F2 letters in the order A T P S C G M joined by '+', optionally ending '+NS'; or exactly U, NS or NA.

F2_detail.description: F2d temperature value or 'T>1', guidance scale or 'hard', 'oracle@N', beam width, final rounding, position rule, variants; '' if none.

CT.description: CT claim types asserted in the abstract (rubric v0.2 step 1 only; descriptive).

list.description: CL checkable claims (abstract and the introduction's contribution list) with their QA8 status.

qa.description: Block QA: the extractor answers sub-items only; 'score' is computed by script from the rules in EXTRACTION-PLAN s6 and is null in extractor output. QA10 = study.venue_line_text plus meta.venue_resolved.

QA1.description: a: repository URL for own code; b: commit, tag, release or archive DOI named; c: release only promised or on request; d: link check (filled by a separate web pass, null here).

QA2.description: a: weights of every model behind the main result released or public with a named source; b: data for the main result public or released; c: missing part only promised or on request.

QA3.description: a: prompts, templates or few-shot setting stated (or no prompt by design); b: steps or NFE and generation length stated; c: value rule determinable (derived from F2 by script, null here); d: hardware stated.

QA4.description: a: main comparison reports two or more runs, seeds or sample sets; b: main comparison states three or more runs; c: repeated runs reported only for another result.

QA5.description: a: interval, SD or SE with stated meaning, or a defined significance test, for the main comparison; b: such uncertainty only for other results, or an undefined plus-minus for the main comparison.

QA6.description: n: main comparison has no baseline (score NA); a: parameter counts of own model and every baseline stated; b: within a factor of two or stated as matched; c: inference budget stated for every arm; d: training budget stated for every trained arm or stated as matched.

QA7.description: n: no credited component (score NA); a: with-versus-without (or replaced) comparison of the credited component; b: everything else stated or shown fixed; c: ablation only of a different or sub-component.

QA8.description: Computed from claims.list statuses; sub-items not used (empty object).

QA9.description: a: limitations section or paragraph; b: at least one failure case, negative result or setting where the method is worse.

units.description: Headline numbers (unit_type H) and within-paper contrasts (unit_type K). Unit ids U01, U02, ... in order of appearance.

evidence.description: Every verbatim quote, read by quote_check.py. cond = field id (S04, D07, F2, QA3d, ...), claim id (CL2) or unit id (U07).

searched.description: For every field answered 'no', 'not_stated', 'NS', 'not stated' or 'none' where a quote would otherwise be required: field id -> sections read, e.g. {"F2": "§4, §5, App. B, Table 7"}.

notes.description: at most 60 words: ambiguities met, rule applied.

quote.description: one contiguous passage of 6 to 40 words copied character for character from fulltext/<id>.txt

loc.description: 'p.<pdf page>, §<section>' or 'p.<page>, Table n, row <label>, column <label>'
where the evidence is, or '' when every sub-item is no

page.description: PDF page from the '=== page N ===' marker

row.description: row label as printed, '' for abstract or text

column.description: column label as printed, '' for abstract or text

setting.description: Sampler and budget of this number, each as printed in the table, caption or the text that governs it, or 'not_stated'.

model.description: row label or model name as printed

value_printed.description: exactly as printed, with unit symbols; must occur inside an evidence quote with cond = unit_id

credited_ablation.description: true if this contrast removes or replaces the credited component (S13); used by QA7

factor.description: what changes between arms, in a few words

levels.description: arm labels or factor levels as printed, in table order

values_printed.description: aligned with levels, exactly as printed

model.description: base model or checkpoint shared by the arms; for RQ2 the diffusion arm

held_fixed.description: stated: the text, caption or table states or shows that only the factor changes

other_changes.description: anything else the paper states changes between arms; '' if none stated

budget_across_arms.description: inference budget (steps, NFE, time) across arms

arm_params_printed.description: parameter count per arm as printed (needed for RQ2), aligned with levels; empty if one model
